column1: # The twin regime's placement frontier (entered 2026-09-02 with the §6.5
# DEFAULT FLIP — rollback-and-replay is the only regime; found by the
# variation lane, test/go/langspec/vary_differential_test.go). Every row
# is GREEN on the interpreter and refuses to compile at Finalize's
# full-placement gate: the check pass performs a bind transition inside a
# wrapped body that no compiled op replays or installs, so the rollback
# would lose it. The old keep-installs default compiled these on the check
# pass's own leftover install — which is the divergence class the regime
# exists to eliminate, so the refusal is a lesser defect than a wrong
# answer, not a resting place. It opened with four shapes; two remain, each
# its own graduation:
#   1. an `import` inside a MULTI-RUN body — a module bind is not one of
#      the BindDef twins the arm-residency bridge installs per element;
#   2. a type def inside a multi-run body whose type expression is
#      ELEMENT-DEPENDENT — the bridge carries the element-independent
#      case now (shape 2 below), and this is what it cannot: each element
#      mints a different node, so no one captured entry stands for them.
# Graduation = resident module binds inside compiled units (1) and an op
# that REBUILDS the type per element rather than re-installing one captured
# body (2); each row then moves to the main corpus.
# SHAPE 3 GRADUATED 2026-09-11 (the fifty-seventh increment), and how this
# file described it is the part worth keeping. It read: a `do` body whose
# CLOSURE compile declines, narrowed a day earlier to the COUNT — "the
# rebuild spills one stack entry per operand, so one slot cannot stand for a
# run of a length the compiler does not know". That sentence is true about
# the REBUILD and was the wrong seating to be looking at. The residual is
# [inert inert REGION], which OpSeatBelowMark has seated since the
# forty-first increment and a body unit has planned since the fifty-fifth;
# the dispatch simply never reached the lowering, because the whole-residual
# multi-out EXACTNESS screen refused the body first — on exactly the count
# the seating it needed does not use.
# The narrowing that misled was itself honest work: the fifty-fourth
# increment removed a real obstacle (a literal under a call result) and
# wrote down what was left, from the code it had just changed. The lesson is
# narrower than "measure more": a "what remains is…" line inherits the last
# reader's vantage point, and the next reader should re-derive it from the
# refusal rather than from the sentence. Row in lang/spec/control.tsv.
# SHAPE 2 NARROWED 2026-09-11 (the fifty-third increment). It read "the
# bridge pairs BindDef twins only (a type twin declines the whole bridge)",
# and that was the mechanism but not the problem. Three things had to be
# true and only the first was plumbing: a type install records NO def-site
# event, so there was nothing to pair (RecordTypeInstall now writes one
# inside the arm-resident bracket, and only there); replaying the captured
# node per element is WRONG even when the expression is element-independent,
# because one *Type in two def-stack levels makes the first `undef` retire
# the level below it (measured: "unresolvable type operand Big"), so the op
# re-installs the captured BODY and each element mints its own node; and
# the expression has to be PROVED element-independent, which is the row
# that stays here.
# SHAPE 4 GRADUATED 2026-09-02, and how it was written here is the part
# worth keeping. It read: a call into a boru-IMPLEMENTED module inside the
# `do` body that imported it "leaves a twin the do-body adoption declines",
# MEASURED but not root-caused. The guess buried in "declines" was that the
# twin had no body site. It had one. The do's keep bracket is a SINGLE
# LATCH, and tryRecordClosure's body compile RE-RUNS the body — so a `do`
# inside a fn that the body CALLS (sift-parse-do's) opened its own bracket
# during that re-run and overwrote the outer one, publishing an EMPTY range
# whose floor already sat past the import's own `Sift` twin. AdoptBodyTwins
# then had nothing to walk. Fixed by the same publication gate the
# multi-run guard had just taken: publish only at FnBodyDepth == 0, the
# exact condition under which a twin can be noted at all. The row moved to
# lang/spec/module-sift.tsv.
